mostWorthwhile.text: Building the supplied deeper skin was most worthwhile: it showed how the outer layer's living cells get supplies even though that layer has no blood vessels.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the sweat gland was straightforward but less interesting; it added the part without much new explanation.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the outer skin layer has no blood vessels and receives supplies from below.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. The named slots made the fittings clear, though adding the nerve endings was the only offered combination at that point.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter: the skin's different jobs and the unexpected blood-supply detail made me curious, even though some fittings were routine.
